create_mcp_client: create an MCPClient instance with a model and optional provider, base_url, and api_key for inference
add_stdio_mcp_server: add a stdio MCP server by specifying command, args, env, and optional allowed_tools to register tools
add_sse_mcp_server: add an SSE MCP server by specifying url, headers, timeout, and optional allowed_tools to register tools
run_chat_completion_with_tools: run a streaming chat completion that processes tool calls, executes MCP tools, and yields chunks and results
test_mcp_client_cleanup: test the MCPClient async context manager cleanup to close sessions and release resources
